summary: Adds a /download endpoint that serves files from the uploads directory by name. Also changes the dev server to bind all interfaces with debug mode on.

findings.title: Path traversal in download endpoint
findings.problem: The download handler joins the name query parameter onto UPLOAD_DIR without any check. A value like ../../etc/passwd or an absolute path such as /etc/passwd escapes the uploads directory.
findings.consequence: Any caller of /download can read any file the server process can read. This exposes secrets, config files and source code.
findings.fix: Use werkzeug safe_join or flask send_from_directory, which reject paths outside the base directory. Return 404 when the resolved path leaves UPLOAD_DIR.

findings.title: Debug server exposed on all interfaces
findings.problem: The change turns on debug mode and binds the server to 0.0.0.0. Debug mode turns on the interactive debugger, which runs code typed in the browser.
findings.consequence: Anyone on the network who triggers an error can run arbitrary code on the host. Together with the new download endpoint, they can also read the debugger PIN inputs.
findings.fix: Restore host 127.0.0.1 and drop debug=True. Read both settings from environment variables if a developer needs them.

findings.title: New download endpoint has no test
findings.problem: The repository has no test for the new download handler. No test covers the missing file case or a traversal attempt.
findings.consequence: A regression in the path check could ship without anyone noticing.
findings.fix: Add tests that request a valid file, a missing file and a ../ path. Assert 200, 404 and 404 in that order.
